name: txt-reviwer
description: Frontend assets for the writing workshop tool

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:vendor
scripts.watch: npm run build:vendor && (tailwindcss -i assets/css/app.css -o app/static/css/app.css --watch & esbuild assets/js/main.js --bundle --outfile=app/static/js/app.js --watch)
scripts.check: for f in assets/js/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && esbuild assets/js/main.js --bundle --outfile=/dev/null
